summary.goal: Implement SSEBroadcaster class as shared infrastructure for the cultivate system. Instantiated once at startup and injected into pipeline stages, BullMQ workers, trend detection, and API routes. Events: signal:new, signal:updated, cluster:new, cluster:updated, cluster:trending, ingestion:progress, ingestion:complete, source:error, source:auth_expired. Heartbeat every 30 seconds to keep connections alive. The broadcaster must NOT live inside the API layer — it is a standalone service consumed by multiple subsystems to avoid circular dependencies.

acceptance_criteria.description: SSEBroadcaster manages a set of connected Response objects for SSE streaming
Heartbeat comment sent every 30 seconds to prevent proxy/load balancer timeouts
Dead client connections cleaned up on error/close events
Typed emit methods for each event type ensure correct payload shapes
GET /events endpoint helper sets correct SSE headers (Content-Type: text/event-stream, Cache-Control: no-cache, Connection: keep-alive)
Broadcaster is injectable — pipeline, workers, and API all receive the same instance

steps.title: Define SSE event type enum and payload types
steps.description: Create src/sse/types.ts. Define CultivateSSEEventType enum: 'signal:new', 'signal:updated', 'cluster:new', 'cluster:updated', 'cluster:trending', 'ingestion:progress', 'ingestion:complete', 'source:error', 'source:auth_expired'. Define typed payload interfaces for each event: SignalNewPayload (signal_id, greenhouse_id, title, source_type), SignalUpdatedPayload (signal_id, fields_changed[]), ClusterNewPayload (cluster_id, greenhouse_id, label), ClusterUpdatedPayload (cluster_id, signal_count, trend?), ClusterTrendingPayload (cluster_id, greenhouse_id, label, trend, velocity_weekly), IngestionProgressPayload (job_id, processed_chunks, total_chunks), IngestionCompletePayload (job_id, signals_created), SourceErrorPayload (source_config_id, error, health), SourceAuthExpiredPayload (source_config_id, name).

acceptance_criteria.description: All 9 event types defined as string literal union
Each event type has a corresponding typed payload interface

steps.title: Implement SSEBroadcaster class

acceptance_criteria.description: addClient registers close handler for automatic cleanup
emit writes correct SSE format to all connected clients
Write errors on dead connections trigger removeClient, not crash
clientCount getter available for health monitoring

steps.title: Implement client connection management and heartbeat
steps.description: Add connection lifecycle management to SSEBroadcaster: start() method that begins a 30-second heartbeat interval sending SSE comment lines (: heartbeat\n\n) to all clients, stop() method that clears the interval and closes all client connections, addClient should set SSE response headers (Content-Type: text/event-stream, Cache-Control: no-cache, Connection: keep-alive) and send an initial connection event. The heartbeat prevents proxy/load balancer idle timeouts.

acceptance_criteria.description: Heartbeat sends SSE comment every 30 seconds
stop() clears interval and properly ends all client responses
addClient sets Content-Type: text/event-stream, Cache-Control: no-cache, Connection: keep-alive
Initial connection event sent on addClient so client knows connection succeeded

steps.title: Add typed emit methods for each event
steps.description: Add typed convenience methods to SSEBroadcaster that enforce correct payload shapes: emitSignalNew(payload: SignalNewPayload), emitSignalUpdated(payload: SignalUpdatedPayload), emitClusterNew(payload: ClusterNewPayload), emitClusterUpdated(payload: ClusterUpdatedPayload), emitClusterTrending(payload: ClusterTrendingPayload), emitIngestionProgress(payload: IngestionProgressPayload), emitIngestionComplete(payload: IngestionCompletePayload), emitSourceError(payload: SourceErrorPayload), emitSourceAuthExpired(payload: SourceAuthExpiredPayload). Each method delegates to this.emit() with the correct event type.

acceptance_criteria.description: Each typed method enforces its specific payload interface at compile time
Calling emitSignalNew with wrong payload shape is a TypeScript error
All 9 event types have corresponding typed emit methods

steps.title: Wire GET /events endpoint helper
steps.description: Create src/sse/handler.ts with a createSSEHandler(broadcaster: SSEBroadcaster) factory function that returns an Express request handler. The handler: sets SSE headers via broadcaster.addClient(res), sends an initial 'connected' event with { clientId, timestamp }, and ensures cleanup on request close. This helper is mounted by the API routes feature at GET /api/cultivate/events. Also export the SSEBroadcaster class and all types from src/sse/index.ts.

acceptance_criteria.description: createSSEHandler returns a standard Express (req, res) handler
Handler sends initial 'connected' event with clientId and timestamp
SSEBroadcaster and all types exported from src/sse/index.ts
Request close triggers client cleanup
